config.villageeconomy.title: Village Economy Configuration
config.villageeconomy.apply_behavior: Changes are saved and applied immediately. No restart or reload is required.
config.villageeconomy.enabled.descriptio: Master switch for Village Economy village tracking and future systems.
config.villageeconomy.debugLogging.descr: Writes additional diagnostic details to the log. Leave disabled during normal play.
config.villageeconomy.villageDetectionRa: Maximum radius, in blocks, used to group and match loaded village records.
config.villageeconomy.marketUpdateInterv: Ticks between loaded-village scans. 1,200 ticks is approximately one minute.
config.villageeconomy.priceChangeStrengt: Controls the size of future price adjustments. 0 disables adjustment and 1 is the allowed maximum.
config.villageeconomy.minimumPriceMultip: Lowest multiplier future economy calculations may apply to a price.
config.villageeconomy.maximumPriceMultip: Highest multiplier future economy calculations may apply to a price.
config.villageeconomy.recoveryRate.descr: Fraction of future market imbalance recovered during each update.
